def add_repo_test_result(
        self, repo_url: str, tier: str, test_result: TestResult
    ) -> Optional[List[int]]:
        """Adds test result for repository.
        Overwrites latest test results and adds to historical test results.
        Test results are kept in order: DEV_COMPATIBLE, STABLE_COMPATIBLE, STANDARD.

        Args:
            repo_url: url of the repo
            tier: tier of the repo (MAIN, COMMUNITY, ...)
            test_result: TestResult from the tox -epy3.x

        Return: List of int
        """
        table = self.database.table(tier)
        repository = Query()

        fetched_repo_json = table.get(repository.url == repo_url)
        if fetched_repo_json is not None:
            repo = Repository.from_dict(fetched_repo_json)

            # Update test results, keeping only one per type and sorting by precedence
            test_type_order = {
                TestType.DEV_COMPATIBLE: 0,
                TestType.STABLE_COMPATIBLE: 1,
                TestType.STANDARD: 2,
            }
            # Remove existing entries of the same test type
            filtered_tests = [
                tr for tr in repo.tests_results if tr.test_type != test_result.test_type
            ]
            # Append new result
            filtered_tests.append(test_result)
            # Sort according to predefined order
            repo.tests_results = sorted(
                filtered_tests, key=lambda tr: test_type_order[tr.test_type]
            )

            # Same for historical test results (also deduplicate by type+version)
            filtered_historical = [
                tr
                for tr in repo.historical_test_results
                if not (
                    tr.test_type == test_result.test_type
                    and tr.terra_version == test_result.terra_version
                )
            ]
            filtered_historical.append(test_result)
            repo.historical_test_results = sorted(
                filtered_historical, key=lambda tr: test_type_order[tr.test_type]
            )

            return table.upsert(repo.to_dict(), repository.url == repo_url)
        return None
